candidateGuidance.scope: Signals flag risks, not a diagnosis of a wrong or missing word.
candidateGuidance.ifNeeded: Preserve original takes/track/receipts. Request at most two bounded candidates for flagged sentence IDs using exactly the same approved TTS request text; compare candidates before choosing. Rebuild with shared tools and rerun current text/PCM audit; do not speed audio up or silently rewrite narration.

limitations: No ASR, phoneme/word recognition, full semantic listening or tone correctness claim.
Shared cut/loudness helpers are used read-only. Float build and quantized PCM quiet-window results may differ at a threshold.
PNG, dynamic, encoded media and actual viewer comprehension are separate reviews.
